problem: Employees were under strain and the company wanted to ease stress.
title: Buffer moves to a four-day work week
context: Buffer ran a one-month pilot in May 2020 to help staff cope with pandemic stress.
decision_made: Move to a four-day work week for the rest of 2020 and later keep it.
action_taken: Surveyed staff during and after the trial and published results.
observed_outcome: Buffer's survey showed higher autonomy and work happiness and lower stress; many staff said productivity was similar. Later surveys showed stress rising slightly and customer service needed a staggered rotation.
lessons: A shorter week can improve wellbeing in a small remote team, but support roles may need different coverage.
limitations: Self-reported surveys, no productivity targets during the trial, and a small, remote, pandemic-era team. Results may not transfer to other companies.

claims.claim_text: Buffer moved to a four-day work week for the rest of 2020.
Buffer's surveys reported higher happiness and lower stress during the four-day week.
